name: Seranit Granit Seramik Sanayi ve Tcrt AS
summary: Established in 1991 and headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, Seranit Granit Seramik Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi specializes in manufacturing and supplying a wide array of ceramic goods. Their product portfolio features various types of tiles, suitable for diverse applications such as bathrooms, kitchens, residential interiors, outdoor areas, building facades, and specialized industrial and commercial environments. Additionally, the company produces bathroom furnishings, including elegant tall cabinets and comprehensive bathroom cabinet ensembles.
